hoaxes.title: Anthropic adds a Claude mode that explains its own share price to shareholders every morning
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 a share, and the stock closed about 9% lower on its second day.

hoaxes.title: Netflix adds a 'skip to the dance number' button for its new animated film Steps
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Steps, an animated film voiced by Ali Wong and Amanda Seyfried, simply arrived on Netflix on November 20.

hoaxes.title: Nintendo's Winter Catalogue has a scratch-and-sniff page for Pokemon Winds and Waves' ocean
hoaxes.truth: Made up. The Japanese catalogue only gave a short text description of the games' islands and vast ocean.

hoaxes.title: Google's new search homepage replaces the search button with a 'surprise me' wheel
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Google's new homepage reportedly shows AI chat history and has no search button at all.
